summary: AI-powered web scraping has shifted from brittle CSS-selector scripts toward LLM- and vision-driven extraction that reads pages the way a human would and self-heals when layouts change. In 2026 the market is dominated by API-first data layers like Firecrawl and full-stack platforms like Apify, while managed cloud-browser infrastructure (Browserbase), MCP-native toolkits, and browser-automation frameworks (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium) increasingly add AI and agent-ready interfaces. The broader AI browser market is projected to grow from $4.5B in 2024 to $76.8B by 2034.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open-source (MIT); costs only arise from hosting/cloud browser infrastructure
ai_features: Integrates with AI agents and LLM-driven navigation frameworks
Supports vision/DOM-based extraction via add-on libraries
Commonly used as the browser layer for AI browser agents
strengths: Auto-waiting and reliable selectors for dynamic pages
tools.best_for: Developers needing robust full browser automation for dynamic pages requiring clicks, form fills, and navigation

tools.name: Puppeteer
ai_features: Used as execution layer for AI browser agents
Pairs with LLM-based extraction pipelines
strengths: Deep Chrome/Chromium control via DevTools Protocol
Great for headless automation and PDF/screenshot generation
tools.best_for: Node.js developers automating Chromium for scraping dynamic JavaScript-heavy pages

tools.name: Selenium
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open-source (Apache 2.0); Selenium Grid self-hosted
ai_features: Integrates with AI/ML test and extraction tools
Used as browser layer for agent frameworks
strengths: Industry-standard, broadest language and browser support
tools.best_for: Enterprise and legacy browser automation across many languages and browsers

tools.name: Firecrawl
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with limited credits; paid plans starting ~$16-19/mo scaling by credits (Hobby, Standard, Growth)
ai_features: Returns clean LLM-ready Markdown/JSON from any URL
Natural-language structured extraction
Handles JavaScript rendering, crawling, and interaction in one API
Search, scrape, and full browser interaction for AI agents
strengths: AI-native API designed for LLM pipelines and agents
Single API and credit balance for search, crawl, and extract
Clean markdown output ideal for RAG
tools.best_for: Developers building AI agents or LLM/RAG pipelines needing URLs turned into structured data

tools.name: Apify
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier ($5 monthly usage credits); paid plans from ~$49/mo (Starter) to Scale and Enterprise
ai_features: AI-ready structured data output for agents and RAG
LLM-powered extraction actors
MCP integrations for agent invocation
strengths: Full-stack scraping platform with thousands of reusable actors
Caching and performance optimizations at scale
tools.best_for: Teams wanting a comprehensive, flexible ecosystem for large-scale data collection and reusable scrapers

tools.name: Scrapy
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open-source (BSD); optional Zyte Cloud paid services
ai_features: Integrates with AI extraction add-ons and LLM post-processing
strengths: Python default for medium-to-large scale crawling
tools.best_for: Python developers building scalable custom crawlers for structured scraping

tools.name: Browserbase
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with limited hours; paid plans from ~$39/mo (Hobby) scaling to Scale/Enterprise
ai_features: Managed cloud browsers for AI agents
Stealth proxies and session persistence for agent workflows
Pairs with Firecrawl and Stagehand for AI-driven automation
strengths: Supports Playwright and Puppeteer control frameworks
tools.best_for: Teams needing managed cloud browser infrastructure for production AI agents while owning automation logic

tools.name: Beautiful Soup
ai_features: Commonly combined with LLMs for parsing and post-processing extracted HTML
strengths: Simplest Python library for parsing static HTML
tools.best_for: Python developers parsing static HTML for small-to-medium scraping tasks

tools.name: Diffbot
tools.pricing_paid: 14-day free trial; paid plans from ~$299/mo (Startup) up to Enterprise
ai_features: AI/ML self-healing extraction at scale
Knowledge Graph and automatic entity extraction
Computer-vision based page understanding
strengths: Self-healing extraction resilient to layout changes
tools.best_for: Enterprises needing automated, self-healing structured extraction at large scale

tools.name: Octoparse
tools.pricing_paid: Free plan with limits; paid from ~$99/mo (Standard) to Professional and Enterprise
ai_features: AI-assisted auto-detection of data fields
Point-and-click AI workflow building
tools.best_for: Non-developers and analysts who need point-and-click data extraction without writing code

tools.name: Browse AI
tools.pricing_paid: Free plan; paid from ~$48.75/mo (Starter) to Professional and Team
ai_features: AI-powered point-and-click robot training
Automatic change monitoring and data extraction
strengths: No-code robots that monitor and extract data
tools.best_for: Non-technical users automating recurring data extraction and site monitoring

tools.name: AgentQL
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with monthly query limits; paid usage-based plans
ai_features: Natural-language queries to locate web elements
AI-resilient selectors that survive layout changes
Semantic element targeting for agents
strengths: Query web data using natural language instead of CSS/XPath
Integrates with Playwright and agent frameworks
tools.best_for: Developers building AI agents that need resilient, natural-language element selection

tools.name: ScrapeGraphAI
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with credits; usage-based paid plans
ai_features: LLM-driven extraction turning URLs into structured data
Natural-language scraping prompts
Graph-based pipelines for AI agents
strengths: Open-source Python library plus hosted API
tools.best_for: Developers wanting LLM-powered, prompt-based structured extraction for AI pipelines
